title: Experimenting with Quantum Entangled Items in Minecraft
description:
In preparation for projects on the Wavetech server, we're going to make our lives easier using some quantum mechanics in Minecraft. Quantum Entangled item stacks allow you to manipulate items inside the inventory of the player from within storage tech machines! This leads to a whole array of possibilities.
